_comment: Codex CLI harness MCP scope for Starlight Orchestrator. Read-only mirror of Claude Code's MCP scope — Codex audits the substrate, never mutates it. Writes route back to Claude Code primary. Built on SIP — see footer.
_loaded_when: /ao adversary mode, security review, second-pair architecture decisions, /openclaw-audit invocations, pre-tag pressure-test
_write_policy: READ-ONLY — Codex must not mutate substrate files. All proposed changes route back to Claude Code primary as PR comments, board verdicts, or handoff packets.

starlight-substrate._purpose: substrate awareness for adversary review — vault reads, IS namespace lookup, attestation verification, memory graph queries

arcanea-mcp._purpose: Arcanea canon read for adversary review when Claude Code has touched canon, Guardians, Vel'Tara archetypes
arcanea-mcp._status: scaffold — wire when Arcanea MCP server lands; Phase 1 dependency

_task_scoped_mcps._comment: Codex's task-scoped MCPs are strictly read-only mirrors of what Claude Code can write to. The mirror exists so adversary review can see what primary saw; the mirror never propagates writes.

github_read._purpose: PR diff read, commit history audit, release verification
github_read._pattern: gh CLI in read-only commands (pr view, pr diff, log, show); writes (gh pr create, gh pr merge) explicitly disallowed

vercel_read._purpose: deploy log audit, runtime log review
vercel_read._pattern: mcp__claude_ai_Vercel__list_deployments, get_deployment, get_runtime_logs — never deploy_to_vercel from this harness

linear_read._purpose: issue / cycle audit when alliance work is under review
linear_read._pattern: list_issues, get_issue, list_comments — never save_issue / save_comment

_secrets_policy._comment: Codex never handles secrets. Any task that requires a token escalates to Claude Code primary. The harness layer at scaffold stage carries no secret-touching surfaces.
